collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was collected

users_present.description: Whether the provider has any users the user_security percentages count. When false, those percentages are null
users_present.x-epack-summary: Whether the provider has any users, as user_count counts them.

user_count.description: Enabled accounts of people in the organization. Guests from other organizations and disabled accounts are not counted. The user_security percentages and policy.mfa_required_coverage_pct count these
user_count.x-epack-summary: Enabled accounts of people in the organization, guests left out.

mfa_user_count.description: Users with any MFA factor enrolled

phishing_resistant_user_count.description: Users with phishing-resistant MFA (WebAuthn or FIDO2) enrolled
phishing_resistant_user_count.x-epack-summary: Users enrolled in phishing-resistant MFA, such as a security key or passkey.

inactive_user_count.description: Users inactive for 90 days or more
inactive_user_count.x-epack-summary: Users with no sign-in or other recorded activity in the last 90 days.

locked_out_user_count.x-epack-summary: Users who are currently locked out.

password_policy_noncompliant_user_count.description: Users whose passwords do not meet current password policy requirements
password_policy_noncompliant_user_count.x-epack-summary: Users whose password does not meet the current password policy.

mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of users with any MFA factor enrolled
mfa_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of users enrolled in MFA.

mfa_phishing_resistant_pct.description: Percentage of users with phishing-resistant MFA (WebAuthn/FIDO2)
mfa_phishing_resistant_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of users enrolled in phishing-resistant MFA, such as a security key or passkey.

inactive_pct.description: Percentage of users inactive for 90+ days
inactive_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of users with no sign-in or other recorded activity in the last 90 days.

locked_out_pct.description: Percentage of users currently locked out
locked_out_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of users who are currently locked out.

weak_password_pct.description: Percentage of users with weak passwords
weak_password_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of users with a weak password.

password_policy_noncompliant_pct.description: Percentage of users whose passwords do not meet current password policy requirements
password_policy_noncompliant_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of users whose password does not meet the current password policy.

user_security.description: Percentages of the provider's users with MFA, with phishing-resistant MFA, inactive, locked out, and with weak or noncompliant passwords. Users who sign in through another identity provider get MFA from that provider. When a provider sends some users elsewhere, its MFA values are left out with a gap that names the other provider.
user_security.x-epack-summary: Sign-in security across the provider's users.

apps_present.description: Whether the provider has any applications the app_security percentages count. When false, those percentages are null
apps_present.x-epack-summary: Whether the provider has any connected apps.

sso_app_count.description: Applications using federated SSO (SAML or OIDC)
sso_app_count.x-epack-summary: Apps set up for SSO through SAML or OIDC.

deprovisioning_app_count.x-epack-summary: Apps where access is removed automatically when a user is deprovisioned.

sso_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of applications using federated SSO (SAML/OIDC)
sso_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of connected apps set up for SSO through SAML or OIDC.

provisioning_enabled_pct.description: Percentage of applications with automated provisioning
provisioning_enabled_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of apps with automated user provisioning.

deprovisioning_enabled_pct.description: Percentage of applications with automated deprovisioning
deprovisioning_enabled_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of apps where access is removed automatically when a user is deprovisioned.

authorized_third_party_apps_count.description: Count of authorized third-party applications or OAuth integrations
authorized_third_party_apps_count.x-epack-summary: Third-party apps and OAuth integrations that users have authorized.

app_security.description: How the provider's apps sign users in and provision them, and how many third-party apps users have authorized.
app_security.x-epack-summary: SSO and automated provisioning for connected apps, and the third-party apps users have authorized.

privileged_users_present.description: Whether the provider has any users privileged_users_count counts. When false, the privileged percentages are null
privileged_users_present.x-epack-summary: Whether any user has a role that can change who has access, reset another user's credentials, or change sign-in or security settings.

privileged_users_count.description: Count of users who hold a role that can change who has access, reset another user's credentials, or change sign-in or security settings. Roles that can only read are not counted. A guest with such a role counts. Roles that manage devices, API access or identity providers, or that can run commands on managed devices, count too.
privileged_users_count.x-epack-summary: Users with a role that can change who has access, reset another user's credentials, or change sign-in or security settings.

super_admin_count.description: Count of highest-privilege administrative accounts (for example Global Admin or Super Admin)
super_admin_count.x-epack-summary: Admins in the highest-privilege role, such as Global Admin or Super Admin.

privileged_mfa_user_count.description: Privileged users with MFA enabled or enforced
privileged_mfa_user_count.x-epack-summary: Admins with MFA enabled or enforced.

privileged_phishing_resistant_user_count.x-epack-summary: Admins with phishing-resistant MFA, such as a security key or passkey.

privileged_mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with MFA enabled or enforced
privileged_mfa_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of admins with MFA enabled or enforced.

privileged_phishing_resistant_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with phishing-resistant MFA
privileged_phishing_resistant_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of admins with phishing-resistant MFA.

standing_privileged_users_present.description: Whether any user holds standing privileged access, as standing_privileged_users_count defines it
standing_privileged_users_present.x-epack-summary: Whether any user has admin access that is always on.

standing_privileged_users_count.description: Count of users with standing privileged access instead of just-in-time or eligible access
standing_privileged_users_count.x-epack-summary: Users who hold admin access at all times. Just-in-time and eligible access do not count.

privileged_access.description: Counts of privileged users and the share of them with MFA and with phishing-resistant MFA.
privileged_access.x-epack-summary: Admins and the share of them with MFA.

accounts_present.description: Whether the provider has any accounts, in any state. When false, the lifecycle percentages are null
accounts_present.x-epack-summary: Whether the provider has any accounts in any state.

account_count.description: Accounts in every state, including suspended and archived accounts. The lifecycle percentages count these
account_count.x-epack-summary: Accounts in every state, including suspended and archived accounts.

suspended_account_count.description: Accounts in a suspended or disabled state
suspended_account_count.x-epack-summary: Accounts that are suspended or disabled.

archived_account_count.description: Accounts in an archived, retained, or soft-deleted state
archived_account_count.x-epack-summary: Accounts that are archived, retained or soft-deleted.

suspended_pct.description: Percentage of accounts in suspended or disabled state
suspended_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of accounts that are suspended or disabled.

archived_pct.description: Percentage of accounts in archived, retained, or soft-deleted state
archived_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of accounts that are archived, retained or soft-deleted.

lifecycle.description: Percentages of users suspended and archived.
lifecycle.x-epack-summary: Share of accounts that are suspended or archived.

mfa_required.description: Whether enforced sign-in policies, one or several together, require MFA of every user on every sign-in, or block the sign-in, whatever the app, client type, device, location or risk. Report-only policies do not count. Users a policy names as exceptions, such as break-glass accounts, do not make this false, and count as not covered in mfa_required_user_count. mfa_required_coverage_pct gives the share of users the requirement covers. A group or organizational unit excluded by name counts as a named exception. A setting that remembers a device and skips MFA on later sign-ins from it does not make those sign-ins uncovered.
mfa_required.x-epack-summary: Whether sign-in policies require MFA, or block the sign-in, for every user on every sign-in, apart from named exceptions such as break-glass accounts.

mfa_required_user_count.description: Users whose every sign-in requires MFA or is blocked, by one enforced policy or several together, out of user_security.user_count
mfa_required_user_count.x-epack-summary: Users whose every sign-in requires MFA or is blocked.

mfa_required_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of users whose every sign-in requires MFA or is blocked
mfa_required_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of users whose every sign-in requires MFA or is blocked.

session_lifetime_max_min.description: Maximum session lifetime across all policies (minutes)
session_lifetime_max_min.x-epack-summary: Longest session any sign-in policy allows before the user must sign in again, in minutes.

idle_timeout_max_min.description: Maximum idle timeout across all policies (minutes)
idle_timeout_max_min.x-epack-summary: Longest idle time any sign-in policy allows before a session ends, in minutes.

legacy_auth_blocked.description: Whether legacy authentication protocols are blocked for every user and every app, by one enforced policy or several together
legacy_auth_blocked.x-epack-summary: Whether sign-in through legacy authentication protocols is blocked.

phishing_resistant_required_for_privileg.description: Whether phishing-resistant authentication is required for privileged users
phishing_resistant_required_for_privileg.x-epack-summary: Whether admins must use phishing-resistant MFA to sign in.

policy.description: Sign-in policy settings: MFA requirements, session limits, and legacy authentication.
policy.x-epack-summary: What the provider's sign-in policies require.

managed_device_required.description: Whether access to core corporate resources requires a managed or compliant device
managed_device_required.x-epack-summary: Whether access to core company resources requires a managed or compliant device.

managed_device_required_for_admins.description: Whether privileged access requires a managed or compliant device
managed_device_required_for_admins.x-epack-summary: Whether admin access requires a managed or compliant device.

device_access.description: Whether sign-in policies require a managed device, for all users and for administrators.
device_access.x-epack-summary: Whether users and admins need a managed device for access.
